name: comp-53

frames.best_why: The copy button has swapped to a check inside a focus ring, showing the copied confirmation.

tagline: Read-only command field whose copy icon turns into a check when clicked.
summary: A single-line read-only text field holding a value to reuse, with a copy button on the right. Hovering shows a small tooltip; clicking copies the text and briefly swaps the icon for a check.
appearance: A dark rounded field with a subtle outline sits under a small label, the value left-aligned in grey-white and a faint copy glyph at the right end. A grey rounded speech bubble floats just above the field while it is hovered.
behaviour: Hovering the icon pops a small tooltip above the field. A click writes the field's value to the clipboard, the copy glyph shrinks away as a green check fades in, the button goes dead to further clicks, and after about a second and a half the icon returns.
demo_content: Label "Copy to clipboard", the value "pnpm install origin-ui" and the tooltip "Copy to clipboard".
search_phrases: npm install snippet with copy button
read only input with copy icon
copy button that shows a check
shareable link field with copy tap
use_when: A value people must reuse elsewhere, like an install command, invite link or ID, where copying is the main action.
avoid_when: The value is a hardcoded default and the button needs the Clipboard API, so it fails outside a secure context.
customise: Nothing is exposed as a prop: the label, the command string and the tooltip copy are literals, so putting in your own value means editing the file.
weight_why: A field, one button and an occasional tooltip; one short scale transition.

a11y.note: The button's aria-label changes to Copied and it disables itself; the scale transitions ignore reduced-motion.

polish_why: Neat tooltip and a clean icon swap; the field itself is otherwise stock.
